correctness.rationale: Unique steady state from positive-definite pinned Laplacian; harmonic interpolation on both arcs and Kirchhoff flux yield x0+xd=1, Delta=k/(k+2G), mean 1/2. Exact arc energy and sum-of-squares identity yield E and V. Pairwise comparisons reduce to positive square-root identities; G_d strictly decreasing yields monotone thresholds, all optimizer switches, endpoint minima and simultaneous opposite placements. Independently solved full pinned linear system in exact rationals for all N=4..15, separations and several positive k, matching E,V and means; all-real result rests on algebra not finite tests.
